composer.title: Meet the Composer
composer.introduction: Nadim F. Tarabay is a Lebanese composer whose musical thought explores memory, self similarity, and fractal geometry. Drawing on Arabic maqam and Maronite chant, he investigates how melodic gestures generate larger structures. Urban polyphony and micropolyphony inform his interwoven musical lines, while resultant harmony and spectral harmony connect melodic interaction with the inner resonance of sound.
composer.story: His works include The Beginning: An Emirati Symphony and Echoes of Time, commissioned by the UAE National Orchestra; Antar and Abla, commissioned by Mubadala; 1001 Nuits: Le Cheval d’ébène, commissioned by the Philharmonie de Paris; and The Word Made Flesh, commissioned by the USJ Choir in Lebanon. As founder of Zagharid, he develops and produces collaborative projects across orchestral music, opera, and sacred vocal forms.
